description: MERGE with subquery sources: VALUES with $n, nested subqueries, joins, aggregates, CTEs, alias forms. Converted 1:1 from dml/MergeSubqueryTest.java (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE dst (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER)

MERGE INTO dst d USING (SELECT $1 AS a, $2 AS b, $3 AS c FROM VALUES(1,2,3), (4,5,6)) s ON s.a = d.a WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET b = s.b, c = s.c WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(a,b,c) VALUES (s.a, s.b, s.c)
SELECT * FROM dst ORDER BY a

CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)

MERGE INTO dst d USING (SELECT p.id, p.name, pr.price FROM products p JOIN prices pr ON p.id = pr.product_id) s ON s.id = d.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET name = s.name, price = s.price WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(id, name, price) VALUES (s.id, s.name, s.price)

MERGE INTO customer_totals ct USING (SELECT customer_id AS id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id) s ON s.id = ct.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET total = s.total WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(id, total) VALUES (s.id, s.total)
SELECT * FROM customer_totals ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE source (id INTEGER, value INTEGER)
